project.name: ELUS
project.description: Contextual human presence platform connecting people, businesses, and services. It is an atmospheric, premium digital human infrastructure, completely avoiding common social network tropes (no infinite feed, no likes, no chat).
project.aesthetic_direction: Hybrid Atmospheric. Premium, dark, minimalist, sophisticated, but human. Graphite/Deep Blue background, discreet glow (no gamer neon), soft particles. Clean look.

glassmorphism.usage: Bottom navigation, Floating headers, Sticky action bars

field_of_presence_radar.description: Dynamic radar visualization (NOT a standard geographic map). A dark atmospheric void where nodes (humans/businesses) float.
field_of_presence_radar.visuals: Graphite/Deep blue background with subtle nebula scattering and soft particles. Nodes pulse gently (0.5s breathing animation).
field_of_presence_radar.logic: Visual prominence maps exactly to compatibility. High compatibility = white, opaque, glowing. Low compatibility = silver, highly transparent.

bottom_navigation.styling: Fixed bottom, mx-4 mb-6 rounded-full backdrop-blur-2xl bg-[#0B101A]/80 border border-white/10 shadow-2xl flex justify-around py-4

buttons.primary: bg-[#5E9EAB] text-white rounded-full px-8 py-4 font-medium hover:bg-[#4A8591] transition-all shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(94,158,171,0.2)]
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#A1A9B8]/30 text-[#EDEDED] rounded-full px-8 py-4 hover:bg-white/5 transition-all

public_profile.layout: Bento-box grid style. No social feeds.
public_profile.blocked_info: Sensitive data (WhatsApp, CV, etc.) uses 'blur-md' utility + 30% opacity, overlaid with a lock icon. User clicks 'Solicitar Acesso' to request.
public_profile.granular_permissions: List of toggle switches for each requested data point, allowing the owner to approve/deny individually.

monetization_cards.premium_person: Dark card with subtle 'Prata Fria' (Cold Silver) metallic gradient border/overlay.
monetization_cards.premium_business: Dark card with 'Ciano Discreto' (Discreet Cyan) glow and glassmorphism inner layers.

motion.radar_sweep: Slow, cinematic rotation (e.g., 10s per full rotation) with a soft conic-gradient mask using framer-motion.
motion.page_transition: Fade in with a slight Y-axis lift (framer-motion: initial opacity 0, y 10 -> animate opacity 1, y 0).
motion.hover_states: Micro-lift (-translate-y-0.5) and subtle text brightness. No violent scale jumps or bouncy springs.

splash_background.description: Abstract blue smoke-like particles swirling against black background. Used for the Splash Screen behind the slogan 'Uma internet mais humana.'

premium_plan_texture.description: Brushed silver metal texture. Use with blend-mode-overlay on the Premium Person/Business cards to create a sophisticated 'prata fria' metallic look.

radar_particle_texture.description: Close-up of particles against a dark background. Useful as a subtle background pattern for the Field of Presence radar.

accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute using kebab-case and role-based naming (e.g., `data-testid='login-submit-button'`, `data-testid='request-access-whatsapp-toggle'`).
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio for all text. Use Matte White (#EDEDED) on the Graphite background (#0B101A) to easily pass WCAG.

instructions_to_main_agent: This is a React Native Expo web app setup but using Tailwind CSS and Shadcn UI in the specified environment. Map the UI accordingly.
Extend tailwind.config.js with the custom colors defined here. Use the exact hex codes for deep blue/graphite (#0B101A), cyan (#5E9EAB), and silver (#A1A9B8).
Prioritize 'Satoshi' font if available, fallback to 'SF Pro Display' or Inter.
The 'Field of Presence' (Radar) MUST NOT look like a Google Map or typical social feed. Use a dark canvas with nodes of varying opacity based on compatibility.
Data privacy is central. Implement the blurred info visual effectively: `blur-md` on text content overlayed with an SVG lock icon.
Forms and inputs must avoid the 'default UI' look. Use the 'neumorphism_dark' styling (subtle borders, deep background) instead of flat white inputs.
Do NOT use bright red notifications or pure neon colors. Keep the UI atmospheric, calm, and human.
